implemented: The music panel stores volume against the channel-specific LiveKit identity __music_bot__:<channelId> rather than changing publisher or server state.
The existing per-participant playout synchronizer applies that value only to the bot microphone source, multiplied by the listener's master volume and deafen state.
The 0-200% accessible slider uses the existing account-preference-backed per-user volume store and does not alter unrelated participants.
remaining: Two independent listeners must verify different audible bot levels with unrelated voice audio unchanged.
release: Source and automated fixtures only; no commit, push, merge, deployment or Windows update was performed.
